description: Unified `determinex` console script installed via pyproject.toml entry_point. All subcommands verified: doctor, status, config show/doctor, evidence validate/render. All existing scripts untouched.
invariants: determinex with no args or --help prints usage and exits 0
determinex config show masks API keys (never prints plaintext key value)
determinex config doctor exits 1 when any safety flag is open
determinex config doctor exits 0 when all flags are closed
determinex evidence validate is strictly read-only (no file mutations)
evidence validate reads manifest_path from evidence_index.json entries
All 48 evidence entries resolve to existing files
Old scripts (determinex_doctor.py, determinex_status.py) remain functional as standalone scripts
pip install -e . --no-deps creates the determinex console script
pyproject_changes: added [project.scripts] section with determinex entry point
